tasks.subject: GAP-HAIP-01: scope value for authorization_code grant
tasks.description:
Close GAP-HAIP-01 (HAIP OpenID4VCI L199 + Authorization Endpoint clause).

Read crates/foundry-issuer/AGENTS.md and crates/foundry-core/AGENTS.md first. Spec: docs/specs/openid4vc-high-assurance-interoperability-profile-1_0.md, "Credential Offer" and "Authorization Endpoint" sections. Cite the spec in code comments per AGENTS.md §4.4.

Changes:
1. foundry-core/src/config/model.rs: add `#[serde(default)] pub scope: Option<String>` to `CredentialType`.
2. foundry-core/src/config/validate.rs: validate effective scope values (scope.unwrap_or(id)) are unique across credential_types; reject empty/whitespace scope.
3. foundry-issuer/src/metadata.rs: add `pub scope: String` to `CredentialConfigurationSupported`, populated with the effective scope. Always serialized.
4. foundry-issuer/src/offer.rs: add `#[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub scope: Option<String>` to `AuthorizationCodeGrant`; populate in create_offer.rs for the authorization_code grant.
5. foundry-issuer/src/authorize.rs: add `pub scope: Option<String>` to `AuthorizeParams`. In handle_authorize_request: if scope is Some, it MUST match the effective scope of tx.credential_type_id, else AuthorizeOutcome error (invalid_scope). If None, fall back to issuer_state resolution as today (documented deliberate leniency).
6. crates/foundry/src/server.rs: parse `scope` from the /authorize query params and pass it through.
7. Update ~16 CredentialType struct-literal fixtures across the workspace.
8. Remove `#[ignore]` from haip_0023_credential_configuration_metadata_carries_a_scope_value (crates/foundry-issuer/tests/conformance_vci.rs:415).
9. Update docs/conformance/openid4vc-conformance.md: delete the GAP-HAIP-01 row from the gap register, and flip affected clause rows (HAIP-0023, HAIP-0027, HAIP-0028, VCI-0145) from gap/not-implemented to conforming with new evidence. crates/foundry/tests/conformance_report.rs enforces two-way consistency between the register and #[ignore] attributes.
10. Update openapi.json if the /authorize query params or metadata shape changed (see crates/foundry/AGENTS.md for the regeneration command).

Gate (AGENTS.md §5.1, scoped ONLY — do NOT run cargo test --workspace):
  cargo test -p foundry-core -p foundry-issuer -p foundry
  cargo clippy -p foundry-core -p foundry-issuer -p foundry --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo fmt --check
Also run `cargo test -p foundry-wallet` since fixtures there change.

tasks.subject: GAP-HAIP-05: x509_hash Client Identifier Prefix
tasks.description:
Close GAP-HAIP-05 (HAIP OpenID4VP L256).

Read crates/foundry-verifier/AGENTS.md and crates/foundry-core/AGENTS.md first.

Spec basis, cite in comments (AGENTS.md §4.4):
- HAIP: "For signed requests, the Verifier MUST use, and the Wallet MUST accept the Client Identifier Prefix `x509_hash`. The X.509 certificate of the trust anchor MUST NOT be included in the x5c JOSE header. The X.509 certificate signing the request MUST NOT be self-signed."
- OpenID4VP 1.0 §5.9.3 (docs/specs/openid-4-verifiable-presentations-1_0.md:616): "the original Client Identifier (the part without the `x509_hash:` prefix) MUST be a hash and match the hash of the leaf certificate passed with the request... The value of `x509_hash` is the base64url-encoded value of the SHA-256 hash of the DER-encoded X.509 certificate."

Changes:
1. foundry-core/src/trust/mod.rs: add `pub fn cert_sha256_thumbprint(leaf_pem: &[u8]) -> Result<String, TrustError>` returning base64url-unpadded SHA-256 over the DER encoding of the leaf cert. Use the existing sha2 dep and x509-cert's to_der. Return ONLY the hash, not the prefixed client_id — keep the prefix construction at the call site.
2. foundry-verifier/src/request.rs `build_signed_request_object` (~line 362-450): stop hardcoding `format!("x509_san_dns:{host}")`. Read `config.verifier.client_id_scheme` (this field already exists in VerifierConfig and is currently dead code). Support exactly two values:
   - "x509_san_dns" -> existing behaviour, keep the match_san_dns cross-check.
   - "x509_hash"    -> client_id = format!("x509_hash:{}", cert_sha256_thumbprint(leaf_pem)). Requires x5c to be configured; if x5c is absent return VerificationError::Crypto explaining that x509_hash requires a certificate.
3. foundry-core/src/config/validate.rs: reject any client_id_scheme other than those two values with ConfigError::Validation. Change the default fixture value to "x509_hash".
4. foundry-verifier/src/verify.rs (~line 386): the unsigned DC API path also derives `format!("x509_san_dns:{host}")`. Per OpenID4VP the DC API path uses a different client id scheme entirely - investigate and leave a documented comment; do NOT silently change DC API behaviour without spec justification.
5. Flip fixtures from client_id_scheme "x509_san_dns" to "x509_hash" where they exercise signed requests. Note crates/foundry/tests/wallet_verification.rs and crates/foundry-wallet/tests/support/mod.rs run real E2E flows - make sure the wallet still accepts the new prefix (it currently treats client_id as opaque and passes it to attach_kb_jwt as the KB-JWT audience, so the audience string changes; confirm the verifier's expected_audiences check matches).
6. Remove `#[ignore]` from gap_haip_05_signed_request_object_never_uses_x509_hash_prefix (crates/foundry-verifier/src/request.rs:776).
7. Update docs/conformance/openid4vc-conformance.md: remove the GAP-HAIP-05 row and flip the affected clause rows (HAIP-0043, VP-0068, VP-0069) with new evidence. conformance_report.rs enforces two-way consistency.

CRITICAL: the client_id doubles as the KB-JWT audience end-to-end. Verify the full E2E verification flow still passes, not just the unit test.

Gate (AGENTS.md §5.1, scoped ONLY — do NOT run cargo test --workspace):
  cargo test -p foundry-core -p foundry-verifier -p foundry -p foundry-wallet
  cargo clippy -p foundry-core -p foundry-verifier -p foundry --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo fmt --check

tasks.subject: GAP-VP-04: validate transaction_data_hashes binding
tasks.description:
Close GAP-VP-04 (OpenID4VP 1.0 L1523 + L3141-3145).

Read crates/foundry-verifier/AGENTS.md, crates/foundry-sd-jwt-vc/AGENTS.md, crates/foundry-wallet/AGENTS.md first.

Spec basis (docs/specs/openid-4-verifiable-presentations-1_0.md:3141-3145), cite in comments:
- `transaction_data_hashes`: non-empty array of base64url-encoded hashes. Each hash is computed over THE STRING received in the `transaction_data` request parameter — base64url decoding is NOT performed before hashing.
- `transaction_data_hashes_alg`: REQUIRED in the KB-JWT when it was present in the request; default sha-256; sha-256 MUST be supported.

Verified ground truth (do not re-derive):
- attach_kb_jwt(issuer_presentation: String, holder_signer: &dyn Signer, audience: &str, nonce: &str) -> Result<String, FormatError> at crates/foundry-sd-jwt-vc/src/builder.rs:127
- build_kb_jwt(holder_signer, audience, nonce, sd_hash) at builder.rs:106; payload is exactly {aud, nonce, iat, sd_hash}
- verify_kb_jwt at crates/foundry-sd-jwt-vc/src/verifier.rs:~300-346 checks aud, nonce, sd_hash, signature
- VerificationTransaction.transaction_data: Option<Vec<String>> already holds the base64url entries EXACTLY as sent (see the doc comment on the field)
- config: VerifierConfig.transaction_data_hashes_alg: Vec<String> exists and is currently never read
- crates/foundry-wallet has ZERO transaction_data references
- This is SD-JWT-VC only; foundry-mdoc has no analogue

Changes:
1. foundry-sd-jwt-vc builder: extend build_kb_jwt/attach_kb_jwt to accept the transaction data binding — suggested shape: an `Option<&TransactionDataBinding>` param carrying the encoded entries plus the chosen alg. When present, add BOTH `transaction_data_hashes` and `transaction_data_hashes_alg` to the KB-JWT payload. Hash the entry strings as-is (no base64url decode first).
2. foundry-sd-jwt-vc verifier: extend verification so a caller can supply the expected transaction_data entries + acceptable algs, and check that the KB-JWT's transaction_data_hashes covers them. Keep the existing signature working for callers that request no transaction data.
3. foundry-verifier/src/verify.rs: when tx.transaction_data.is_some(), push a NEW named CheckResult `transaction_data_binding`. Per AGENTS.md §4.3 this is a POLICY outcome: a missing or mismatched binding means HTTP 200 with verified:false, NOT a 400. Never hardcode verified (§4.2) — it stays checks.iter().all(|c| c.passed).
4. foundry-wallet: parse `transaction_data` out of the incoming request object in actions/verification.rs and pass it into attach_kb_jwt so the E2E flow actually produces a bound presentation. Must return WalletResult/WalletError, no unwraps (§4.1).
5. Add the `transaction_data_binding` check name to the §4.2 list in the root AGENTS.md and to crates/foundry-verifier/AGENTS.md.
6. Remove `#[ignore]` from gap_vp_04_transaction_data_hashes_never_validated (crates/foundry-verifier/src/verify.rs:900). That test asserts a presentation WITHOUT the binding fails. Also add a positive test: a presentation WITH a correct binding verifies.
7. Update docs/conformance/openid4vc-conformance.md: remove the GAP-VP-04 row, flip VP-0153 and the Transaction Data clause rows (incl. VP-0254) to conforming with new evidence. conformance_report.rs enforces two-way consistency.

Gate (AGENTS.md §5.1, scoped ONLY — do NOT run cargo test --workspace):
  cargo test -p foundry-sd-jwt-vc -p foundry-verifier -p foundry -p foundry-wallet
  cargo clippy -p foundry-sd-jwt-vc -p foundry-verifier -p foundry --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo fmt --check

tasks.subject: GAP-HAIP-03: DPoP sender-constrained access tokens (RFC 9449)
tasks.description:
BLOCKED ON USER DECISION — do not start until the DPoP breadth question is answered.

Close GAP-HAIP-03 (HAIP OpenID4VCI L163: "Sender-constrained access token: MUST support DPoP as defined in RFC9449").

RFC 9449 has been vendored to docs/specs/rfc9449-dpop.txt. A row MUST be added for it to the §4.4 spec table in the root AGENTS.md (per §8 "Maintaining These Files").

Proposed design (pending confirmation) — opt-in per request:
- DPoP header present at /token -> verify proof, bind cnf.jkt, respond token_type "DPoP".
- DPoP header absent -> Bearer, exactly as today. RFC 9449 §5 explicitly permits this.
- New config: issuer.dpop = optional | required | disabled, default optional.
- DPoP-Nonce (RFC 9449 §8) is a MAY: accept a `nonce` claim if present but never issue a challenge. Documented deliberate non-implementation in crates/foundry-issuer/AGENTS.md Gotchas.
- jti replay protection reuses the existing claim_pop_jti machinery from attestation.rs.

Verified ground truth (do not re-derive):
- crates/foundry-issuer/src/token.rs: mint_and_save_tokens sets token_type "Bearer" literally; access_token is opaque format!("at_{}", Uuid::new_v4().simple()); TokenResponse is {access_token, token_type, expires_in}.
- IssuanceTransaction (crates/foundry-issuer/src/transaction.rs:10) is serde_json-serialized into the "issuance_tx" KV namespace — adding a jkt field needs NO SQL migration, but DOES need #[serde(default)] for rows written by an older build.
- crates/foundry/src/server.rs:607-620 credential_handler hardcodes strip_prefix("Bearer ") — must also accept "DPoP " and reject a DPoP-bound token presented as Bearer (RFC 9449 §7.2).
- server.rs already has an exactly_one_header(&HeaderMap, name) helper (~line 440) used for the OAuth-Client-Attestation headers — reuse it for the DPoP header (RFC 9449 §4.3 check 1 requires rejecting duplicates).
- foundry_core::obs::thumbprint_bytes(&serde_json::Value) -> Result<[u8;32], String> already implements RFC 7638 fail-closed. Use it, NOT the infallible logging-only thumbprint().
- crates/foundry-issuer/src/proof.rs verify_holder_proof is the closest existing analogue for JWS-with-jwk-header verification; follow its shape. josekit is the JOSE library in use.
- AuthorizationServerMetadata (metadata.rs:50) needs dpop_signing_alg_values_supported.

RFC 9449 §4.3 checks to implement: exactly one DPoP header; well-formed JWT; all required claims; typ == dpop+jwt; alg asymmetric and supported; signature verifies under the jwk header; jwk contains no private key; htm matches method; htu matches URI ignoring query/fragment; iat within an acceptable window; at a protected resource, ath == base64url(SHA-256(ascii(access_token))) AND the proof key matches the token's bound key.

Error handling: new IssuanceError variants, each with a kind() arm; exactly one log record emitted in the server.rs error mapper, never at the call site (AGENTS.md §4.5). No unwrap/expect/panic in request paths (§4.1). RFC 9449 uses error code invalid_dpop_proof.

Also: remove #[ignore] from haip_0009_token_response_uses_dpop_token_type (crates/foundry-issuer/tests/conformance_vci.rs:899). NOTE that test currently sends NO DPoP proof and asserts token_type == "DPoP", which is not RFC-conformant behaviour — it must be rewritten to send a real proof.
Update docs/conformance/openid4vc-conformance.md (remove GAP-HAIP-03 row, flip HAIP-0009 and related rows) and openapi.json.

Gate (AGENTS.md §5.1, scoped): cargo test -p foundry-core -p foundry-issuer -p foundry -p foundry-wallet; clippy on the same; cargo fmt --check.
